verdict.rationale: CRA documents a sanctioned representative rail. Representatives use the Represent a Client portal to request online access to an account (cra-docs-18), and account holders can authorize access to their online information (cra-docs-10). Representatives can file returns or make payments for business clients (cra-docs-11), and an EFILE channel lets enrolled filers transmit returns through CRA-certified software (cra-docs-14, cra-docs-19, cra-supp-3). Missing for 10: detail on how a business authorizes a representative and what access levels or scopes are granted, business-specific (not just T1) delegated filing detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
